variable.name: app-sim
variable.when: 1. Create `user` on the first turn; it is the protagonist. 2. Add an object to its collection as a whole object the first time it appears.
variable.desc: 1. Afterwards change only the fields that changed; never rewrite untouched fields. 2. Keys are stable ids, never names: when an unknown's name is learned, set `name` and keep the key. 3. No field may be empty; infer it from context.
